title: Microphone Frequency Visualization with FFT
description: A MicroSim that shows the frequency spectrum of sound coming in from a microphone using the p5.js fft library.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Microphone
learningObjectives: Explain how an FFT converts a microphone signal from the time domain into a frequency spectrum of amplitude versus frequency
Identify the peak frequency of a whistle or hum from the displayed spectrum and its reported value
Compare the spectra produced by a pure whistled tone, a spoken vowel, and broadband noise, and relate the differences to harmonic content
Predict how narrowing the Max Frequency slider rescales the horizontal axis and which bars remain visible
Trace the data path from the p5.js AudioIn object through the FFT analyzer to the color-coded frequency bars redrawn each frame
